title: Minimalist Machine
summary: Visible structure. Precise type. Interfaces that feel like instruments.
lede: A quiet technical aesthetic: the interface exposes its parts, relationships, and purpose with very little decoration.

grammar.text: Thin rules, outlined boxes, and explicit connections organize the surface.
Plain sans-serif headings; monospaced labels, values, and object names.
White or pale canvases with dark marks. Use strong color sparingly for emphasis or state.
Room between groups; density inside a task or a connected system.

synthesis: [Detail](ref:detail-blog) brings editorial scale and polish: bold headings, ordered rows, and small technical labels.
[Pure Data](ref:pure-data) brings exposed logic: named objects and visible signal paths on a plain canvas.
This collection name and the shared grammar are curatorial interpretations. The references do not claim this style label.

do: Use rows and separators for collections of information.
Use connections to explain actual relationships.
Balance a spacious overview with compact working areas.
dont: Do not imitate the surface with small type, fake terminal output, or decorative wiring. Keep labels readable, links obvious, and relationships real.

fingerprint.note: Thin rules and outlined boxes organize the surface.
Strong color only for emphasis or state.
